cards.title: Convex-roof minimum of energy variance
cards.role: Defines the physical variational object and the acceptance identity for the optimal ensemble.

checks.reason: Eq. (2) defines the minimization and the immediately following footnote states F_Q=4 times the optimal average variance.

The independently constructed minimum-variance ensemble reproduces the spectral QFI identity at paper scale; the complete 214-state dynamics shell gives an absolute QFI-versus-four-times-variance error of 2.53e-13.

cards.numerical_form: Compare 4*sum_i p_i*(<H^2>_i-<H>_i^2) with the spectral QFI formula.

cards.title: Effective state Hamiltonian in the rho eigenbasis
cards.role: Provides the stable numerical construction of H_rho for every target.

checks.reason: The defining Lyapunov equation is Eq. (3).
In the rho eigenbasis the left side is (lambda_m+lambda_n)(H_rho)_mn/2 and the right side is sqrt(lambda_m lambda_n) H_mn.
If [rho,H]=0, off-diagonal H_mn vanish between unequal rho eigenspaces and H_rho=H on the support, as stated by the paper.

cards.numerical_form: For rho proportional to exp(-beta H0), use factor sech(beta*(e_m-e_n)/2) in the H0 eigenbasis; this cancels the partition function and avoids underflow.

cards.title: Yu optimal ensemble reconstruction
cards.role: Maps eigenvectors of H_rho to normalized optimal representatives and their populations.

checks.reason: The projector identity and representative-energy identity are Eq. (4).
Choosing |phi_i>=sqrt(rho)|Psi_i>/sqrt(p_i) gives unit norm by the definition of p_i.
Summing p_i|phi_i><phi_i| inserts the complete eigenbasis of H_rho and returns rho.
Sandwiching Eq. (3) between an H_rho eigenvector gives <phi_i|H|phi_i>=E_rho,i.

cards.numerical_form: Diagonalize H_rho; p_i=sum_m lambda_m |Psi_mi|^2; Phi_mi=sqrt(lambda_m) Psi_mi/sqrt(p_i).

cards.title: Leaf-canonical ensemble
cards.role: Generates the canonical curve inside a fixed leaf and explains the black curves in Main Fig. 1.

checks.reason: The density-matrix expression is Eq. (7).
Expanding the exponential in the H_rho0 eigenbasis gives p_i proportional to exp(-beta E_rho0,i), then EQ003 reconstructs the density matrix.
The denominator is exactly the trace of the numerator.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the matrix exponential through the eigendecomposition of H_rho0 and normalize by sum_i exp(-beta E_i)<Psi_i|rho0|Psi_i>.

cards.title: Leaf-typicality observable and outlier diagnostic
cards.role: Defines all Main Fig. 2-left and Figs. S1-S4 curves.

checks.reason: Eq. (8) gives the ratio; the following numerical paragraph defines shells, shell averages, N_Delta, and log_d N_Delta.
Substituting the normalized representative from EQ003 turns the ratio into <phi_i|O|phi_i>.
For Delta=0, 0<=N_Delta<=d; for Delta above the maximum residual, N_Delta=0. The plotted logarithm is therefore bounded by 0 and 1 when defined.

cards.numerical_form: Sort by E_rho, compute a local shell mean over consecutive levels, residuals abs(o_i-f_i), count residuals above each Delta, and report log(N_Delta)/log(d).
open_questions: The paper states O(sqrt(d)) consecutive levels but omits the integer shell width, centred/blocked choice, and edge handling; these are parameter-reconstruction questions, not formula-gate failures.

cards.title: Spin-chain Hamiltonian
cards.role: Defines H and H0 for every many-body numerical target.

checks.reason: The Hamiltonian appears in Main Eq. (9) and is repeated as Supplemental Eq. (S1); all coupling values are in figure captions.

Independent Pauli-string construction is Hermitian for both disclosed boundary choices, agrees with direct product-state Pauli actions, and supports the attested paper-scale spectral and conservation checks.

cards.numerical_form: Construct sparse Pauli strings; nonintegrable h=((sqrt(5)+5)/8,1/2,sqrt(5)/2), D=pi/20; H0 has h=(0,0,3/2) or (0,0,1/2), D=0.
open_questions: Boundary conditions are omitted. Open boundaries are the leading reconstruction because the text says the generic Hamiltonian has no obvious global symmetries, whereas periodic uniform couplings would retain translation symmetry.

cards.title: Representative-state dynamics and delta selection
cards.role: Selects the pure representative and its comparison shell for Main Fig. 2-right.

checks.reason: The Main Fig. 2 caption states delta_i, the minimization rule, the delta-shell, L=12, beta=0.5, and confidence levels.
The numerator has energy units and the square root of variance plus QFI/4 has the same energy units.

cards.numerical_form: Compute exact mixed-state dynamics under H; choose argmin delta_i; evolve that representative; use the stated normalized delta-shell and empirical 16/84 and 2.5/97.5 percentiles as the initial confidence-band reconstruction.
open_questions: The exact conversion from outlier fraction to confidence bands is not further specified; empirical shell quantiles are a disclosed reconstruction.

cards.title: Symmetric logarithmic derivative and QFI
cards.role: Provides an independent spectral check of the QFI used in EQ001 and EQ007.

checks.reason: Both identities appear in the End Matter as Eqs. (10) and (14).
Solving the SLD equation in the rho eigenbasis gives L_mn=2i(lambda_m-lambda_n)H_mn/(lambda_m+lambda_n), which yields the standard spectral QFI.
If [rho,H]=0, L=0 and F_Q=0.

cards.title: Spectral-compression entropies
cards.latex: S_{\rm diag}^{(H)}[|\chi_i\rangle]= -\sum_\Psi |\langle\Psi|\chi_i\rangle|^2\log|\langle\Psi|\chi_i\rangle|^2,\quad \Delta s_{\rm diag}=\frac{\overline S_{\rm diag}^{\rm eig}-\overline S_{\rm diag}^{\rm mv}}{L}
cards.role: Defines Figs. S5-S6 and the claimed exponential compression.

checks.reason: The Supplemental spectral-compression section defines the dephased projector, diagonal entropy, weighted entropies, and Delta s_diag.
For a normalized representative and complete H eigenbasis, sum_Psi |<Psi|chi_i>|^2=1.
The participation number exp(S_diag) lies in [1,d], reaching 1 for an H eigenstate and d for a uniform energy distribution.

cards.numerical_form: Transform both the H0 eigenvectors and optimal representatives into the H eigenbasis; compute columnwise Shannon entropy and population-weighted means.
